name: Vocational Training to the Dependents
benefit:
- Cost of training to each trainee ₹15,000/-.
- Free boarding and lodging for trainees.
- Placement-linked training, ensuring better job prospects.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a dependent (spouse or adolescent child) of a registered construction worker.
1. The worker should be registered with the A.P. Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
